title: Uncertainty-Aware Contrastive Sentence Embedding With Local Context Representation for Text Classification
subcategory: task adaptation of frozen LLM embedders with probabilistic (Gaussian) sentence embeddings
task: Text classification with task-adapted sentence embeddings (MTEB classification)
problem: Deterministic sentence embeddings ignore local context dependencies and semantic ambiguity, which hurts downstream classification.
architecture: Frozen LLM embedder token matrix -> uncertainty-aware TextCNN (kernels 3/4/5) that outputs a mean vector and a variance (reparameterisation); uncertainty-aware loss plus label-wise contrastive loss (LCL); mean vector used at inference.

datasets.name: MTEB (English, v2) classification
datasets.details: eight tasks: Amazon, Banking77, IMDb, MTOP domain, MASSIVE intent/scenario, Toxic, Tweet sentiment

key_results: Average accuracy over eight tasks: 92.05 (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B + method), 92.20 (F2LLM-0.6B), 92.22 (embeddinggemma-300m) vs 90.47, 88.10, 90.31 for the reproduced baselines.
Leaderboard scores of larger models are lower, e.g. Qwen3-Embedding-8B 90.43 and Gemini Embedding 90.05.
strengths: Lightweight head on frozen embedders lets small models beat larger ones on classification.
Ablations isolate uncertainty and label-wise contrastive modules.

limitations.text: Only English; languages with different tokenisation (e.g. Chinese, Japanese) not studied.
Supervised, task-specific adaptation: the embeddings are tuned per classification task rather than general-purpose.
